Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class GameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.GameTestSupport
public final class GameTestSupport extends Object
NeoForge-native scaffolding for the GameTests: the unprefixed template name, IItemHandler capability access through Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK, and the level's fake player. Everything loader-neutral lives in GameTestScaffold.

  • Field Details

    • TEMPLATE

      public static final String TEMPLATE
      Bare structure path. NeoForge prepends the @GameTestHolder namespace, and every holder is @PrefixGameTestTemplate(false), so this resolves to data/somestacks/structure/somestacks_empty.nbt with no class-name segment.

    • fakePlayer

      public static net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer fakePlayer(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level)
      The level's shared fake player, standing in for automation. This is the same actor NeoForgeEditAuthority uses, and NeoForge still ships FakePlayerFactory, so there is nothing to reconstruct by hand.
